title: Keep inference source-owned
prompt: In the current Seloryn checkout, complete the small source-owned inference workflow in the task fixture: define the bounded computation, evaluate a holdout input, validate the model contract, and expose a reproducible result. The acceptance path must not hide the work behind a native trainer helper. Do not change VERSION.toml, publish, or use the network. Emit only the observable acceptance fields in the task-named adapter file.
